present.purpose: runtime characterization with relevant optional packages installed
present.source_import: lane worktree selected through PYTHONPATH; each lane reported gwexpy.__file__ inside its own worktree

base.purpose: isolated clone with the relevant optional packages actually uninstalled; no monkeypatching
base.source_import: lane worktree selected through PYTHONPATH; each lane reported gwexpy.__file__ inside its own worktree

isolation.source: All runtime lanes used separate worktrees created at source_sha. No lane rebased or updated during characterization.
isolation.python_environment: present and base are separate environment prefixes. The base profile removed optional packages from an isolated environment instead of changing import behavior in-process.
isolation.immutability: Both audit environments were read-only after setup.
